facts.text: The Blue and Gold Opportunity Plan ensures UC systemwide tuition does not deter California households with incomes below $80,000.

sources.title: Blue and Gold Opportunity Plan - Glossary - UCSB Office of Financial Aid and Scholarships
sources.quote: The goal of the new “Blue and Gold Opportunity Plan” is to ensure that UC systemwide tuition does not deter the half of California households with incomes below $80,000 from aspiring to a UC education.

facts.text: Students applying for admission to the College of Creative Studies choose one of nine majors, such as Art, Biology, Mathematics, or Physics.

sources.title: About | UCSB College of Creative Studies
sources.quote: When they apply for admission, students choose one of nine majors offered by CCS: Art, Biology, Chemistry and Biochemistry, Computer Science, Marine Science, Mathematics, Music Composition, Physics, or Writing and Literature.
